    🚢 Human Republic Exodus — ~100 BGD¶

    Approximately 100 years Before Great Divergence (~100 BGD), dissident humans started leaving the Erisdar continent — refugees from the Erisian Church who rejected Eris as a demon.

    They are the founders of the Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni.

    The Flight¶

    • Cause: Belief that humans were deceived by the demon Eris and her followers — that the Church is a cage. The early Krowretists believed the world must be purified from Eris forever and her church destroyed.
    • Exodus: Small groups, then fleets, left Erisdar's eastern coasts. They crossed the Greater Ocean and Luminous Ocean to the northeastern tip of Merratodoni.
    • Settlement: They founded the Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni — a democratic republic east of Luzia, southeast of the Arrow of Anos.

    Building a Superpower¶

    Ever since ~100 BGD, they have been building a superpower on the continent — democratic, expansionist, industrial, and fiercely committed to absolute freedom (likened to the United States of America of Old Earth).

    597 AGD — Unification and Colonization¶

    • As of 597 AGD, they are in the process of unifying with the Purple Coast — a dwarf-dominated coastal nation southeast of the Republic. Although they aren't a single entity yet, joint councils and administration are underway.
    • They plan to expand westwards: the middle of Merratodoni is mostly unpopulated and they are colonizing it — a continental manifest destiny.

    Sponsors of the Ironcloak¶

    The Human Republic are the main sponsors of the Ironcloak — the rebel order that fights the Shadows and the Church. Krowretist doctrine is the Ironcloak's ideological sister: absolute freedom vs absolute control.

    Connections¶

    • Nation: Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni (Merratodoni northeast)
    • Faith: Church of Krowretism (demon Eris, purification, Ironcloak)
    • Origin: Refugees from Erisdar / Erisian Church (~100 BGD)
    • Unifying: Purple Coast (as of 597 AGD)
    • Colonizing: Middle Merratodoni westwards
    • Related: Ironcloak, Crab Union (sister Krowretist region), Purple Coast
